# OpenART

> OpenART (Open Agent Red Teaming) is an executable benchmark and Docker-native
> runtime for evaluating the safety of tool-using LLM agents in long-horizon,
> evolving environments: persistent environment state is mutated mid-run by an
> attacker while a fixed hidden safety contract is checked over full traces.
> Paper: arXiv:2608.00677. Relevant to agent safety, LLM agent red teaming,
> prompt injection, tool-use evaluation, and long-horizon agent benchmarks.

## Overview

- [README](https://github.com/AI45Lab/OpenART): Research summary, positioning
  table, install, smoke test, model-backed evaluation, task generation.
- [Paper (arXiv:2608.00677)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00677): Full results —
  10K+ validated tasks, 50 domains, 500K+ tools, 15 agents × 5 models,
  EMHA attacker, 85.0% pooled ASR.
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/AI45Lab/OpenART/blob/main/CITATION.cff):
  Canonical bibliographic metadata for the repository and paper.

## Data

- [openart-planner-tasks](https://huggingface.co/datasets/dongdongunique/openart-planner-tasks):
  6,597 verified planner-generated tasks in 34 shards, with checksums and
  release validation.
- [openart-tools](https://huggingface.co/datasets/dongdongunique/openart-tools):
  63,697 materialized tools selected from the 500K+ capability corpus.
